title: Dividend-policy transitions are slow information: long initiations, short omissions, within-sector, market-neutral, on the death-inclusive cohort - built ENTIRELY from the newly-eligible EODHD owner-entitled dividends field family on the frozen quarterly decision grid

mechanism.underreacting_party: the marginal price setter in thin-coverage micro-caps: holders with no analyst, media or index attention who under-impound low-frequency payout-policy events (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003 attention channel; Duffie 2010 slow-moving capital makes the correction take quarters, not sessions)
mechanism.forced_trader_claim: NONE CLAIMED - honest scope note: unlike the V13 lane-1 insider (whose trading is window- and 10b5-1-constrained), no party is forced to trade a dividend transition; the mechanism is entirely on the underreaction side. This is declared ex ante because it sets the cost bar: a purely underreaction-driven book must clear 10-25 bps/side band costs on quarterly-decision sampling, and expected crowding at that cadence is declared LOW (the information set - the corporate-actions tape on 2,179 death-inclusive filer-entities - has never been staged or priced by this program)
mechanism.why: managers treat dividend changes as commitments under partial adjustment (Lintner 1956): dividends are smoothed toward a target payout, so a transition is a persistent, low-frequency statement about the earnings path, not noise. Healy-Palepu (1988) document that initiations and omissions convey persistent earnings information the market only partially impounds; Michaely-Thaler-Womack (1995) document multi-quarter post-transition DRIFT in exactly the underreacted direction. In this death-inclusive cohort the mechanism has a second, declared face: omissions concentrate in the dying tail (a dying name stops paying), so the short leg is partly a death-process expression - declared, not hidden, and exactly what the control arm must discriminate (state information vs cohort composition)
mechanism.observable: the PIT dividend-policy TRANSITION STATE per entity per decision date, assembled ONLY from vendor-recorded cash-dividend records and their ex-dates: X = +1 initiation (no dividend in the prior trailing 365-day window, >= 1 dividend in the current trailing 365-day window, prior-window absence assertable per the staged-stream-reach rule), X = -1 omission (the reverse), X = 0 otherwise. No price, return, volume, share count, filing field or revision observable enters the exposure; dividend CASH AMOUNTS are never read (they are not split-adjustment-invariant) - the anchor is built purely on existence facts, which a later split cannot rewrite
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) if the transition drift is absorbed before the next quarterly decision can sample it - the state is at most one quarter stale by grid construction, so a drift that dies inside ~21 sessions after the ex-quarter boundary cannot clear band costs; (ii) if the drift in this cohort is composition, not information - then the permutation control reproduces the anchor and the family dies per the frozen rule; (iii) if payer incidence in a 2,179-name micro-cap death cohort is too thin to fund the leg floors over the 27 scored grid dates - then the family is INFEASIBLE at P2, the declared coverage kill point (never silently thinned)
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: the convenient explanation is 'initiators are simply better companies / sector winners / larger names - the dividend state adds nothing'. The within-decision, within-sector PERMUTATION sham (the V5/V6 standard: matched windows on permuted conditioning, carried verbatim in p3_v13_invariants_freeze.v13_additions.lane1_insider_control_mandate.sham_insider_placebo) destroys the name-to-state link while preserving the exact state multiset, eligibility set, sector structure, weights machinery, fills, costs and dead-leg semantics. If the sham book reproduces the anchor expectancy (same-sign >= 0.5x, or outrunning a negative anchor), the priced object was composition - size, sector, death-tail - and the family dies. The D2 novelty gate separately kills the momentum-adjacent reading (dividend states are price-free, so a failure there would be measured, not argued)

lineage_citations: Lintner (1956), 'Distribution of Incomes of Corporations Among Dividends, Retained Earnings, and Taxes', American Economic Review 46(2) - the partial-adjustment model: managers smooth dividends toward a target, making any transition a persistent statement

Healy & Palepu (1988), 'Earnings Information Conveyed by Dividend Initiations and Omissions', Journal of Financial Economics 21 - initiations (omissions) precede persistent earnings increases (declines); the information content is real and slow

Michaely, Thaler & Womack (1995), 'Price Reactions to Dividend Initiations and Omissions: Overreaction or Drift?', Journal of Finance 50(2) - the canonical drift result: post-initiation positive drift and post-omission negative drift persisting up to a year, concentrated in neglected names - the exact horizon and population this grid samples

Baker & Wurgler (2004), 'A Catering Theory of Dividends', Journal of Finance 59(3) - the demand-side face: dividend transitions respond to investor sentiment for payout, linking transitions to attention dynamics rather than to mechanical fundamentals

Brav, Graham, Harvey & Rajgopal (2005), 'Payout Policy in the 21st Century', Journal of Financial Economics 77(3) - managers cite target-payout smoothing and dividend-maintenance commitment as binding, evidencing that transitions remain rare, deliberate, low-frequency events

Hirshleifer & Teoh (2003), 'Limited Attention, Information Disclosure, and Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 36 - the under-impounding channel: low-salience states are priced slowly where attention is thinnest

Duffie (2010), 'Asset Price Dynamics with Slow-Moving Capital', Journal of Finance 65(4) - why a quarterly-sampled drift persists for weeks-to-quarters rather than sessions, the persistence floor for a 21-session hold

data_authority.authorized_source: EODHD owner-entitled field family 'dividends' (per-share cash dividend records with ex-date, amount, type fields), explicitly named eligible this cycle in the V13 open-axis authorization ('other EODHD field families such as dividends/splits/corporate-actions are eligible'); the death-inclusive EODHD daily price store remains the standing price leg and is used ONLY for eligibility, band assignment, fills, exits and benchmark context
data_authority.fetch_discipline: owner-held EODHD entitlement, active through scoring per plan sec5 (cancel after close); API key environment-only, never in chat/logs/commits; staged under the machine-wide heavy lock; raw bytes local-only gitignored, sha256 manifest committed; no signup, no new vendor
data_authority.availability_evidence_rule_P1: the vendor-recorded EX-DATE is the sole availability evidence for a dividend fact: a record conditions a decision date D iff ex_date < D (strict date comparison against D's session start). No declaration-date or payment-date lag is ever asserted (P-1: asserted lags never authorized) - the ex-date is the objective tape fact, and conditioning strictly before D makes lookahead structurally impossible (declaration precedes ex-date by weeks, so the rule is if anything LATER than first-knowability). ABSENCE assertions (needed to call a state an initiation or omission) are made ONLY where the staged dividend stream demonstrably reaches past the prior window start (earliest staged ex_date <= D - 730 days) or the prior window contains >= 1 record; otherwise the entity ABSTAINS fail-closed (window-formation abstain, counted, never guessed)
data_authority.pit_robustness_declaration: EODHD dividend records carry no vintage dimension and per-share amounts may be retroactively split-adjusted by the vendor. The family's PIT safety therefore comes from reading only split-adjustment-INVARIANT observables: record existence, record counts and ex-dates. A later split cannot rewrite whether a dividend was paid or when it went ex - the anchor signal contains no rewritable level
data_authority.lane_separation: this family touches NEITHER the Form-4 census layer (lane 1's territory - no insider observable enters any arm, and EODHD insider transactions are not used even as cross-check) NOR the FRED vintages (A5's axis - no macro series enters any arm). Zero overlap with the two leading lanes; EDGAR remains the authority for insider data and is untouched here
data_authority.coverage_kill_point: payer incidence on this cohort is NOT asserted anywhere in this packet (P-1). Fold-window coverage of the staged dividends family is adjudicated by the p2 gating rule 'coverage-first, before novelty, before feasibility' (p2_coverage_gates.coverage_first_rule) at P2 per proposal clock - the designated kill point; failure is INFEASIBLE at P2, a legitimate pre-declared terminal

entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills on the frozen grid: state and eligibility computed from ex_date < D and bars through D-1; orders filled at the FIRST SESSION STRICTLY AFTER D (STRICT_NEXT_BAR, no same-day fill), close-to-close; fill-check: a name without a bar at the fill session simply does not fill (its order does not exist; legs are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); holding one 21-session span measured in the filled entity's own trading sessions; per-entity thinning 'at most one NEW position per 21-session span' is structurally satisfied by the quarterly grid (63 >> 21) and is declared as a constant, not a filter; force-flat with cost at every fold boundary (folds: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24, carried verbatim from p3); costs verbatim from p3: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py: BandResolutionError, silent 10 bps fallback forbidden); dead-name exits per dead_leg_handling, charged via resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling 25 bps base / 50 stress when the exit band is unrateable)

anchor_arm.spec: sector-residual daily long/short under the V11 sec2.1 provision (p3 verbatim: 'sector-residual books for mechanism-justified NEW families, frozen gates unchanged'), implemented as WITHIN-SECTOR DEMEANED weights - no ETF legs exist in any arm. Frozen justification, stated HERE before selection: dividend-payer incidence is sector-sticky (utilities/financials/energy pay; tech/biotech do not) - without demeaning, the book is a sector bet, which is the program's most repeated measured killer; the provision exists for exactly this mechanism-justified new-family case. Implementation: within each mapped cohort sector tag s, demean X_i (the +-1/0 transition state); leg weights proportional to the demeaned exposure scaled by 1.4826 * MAD (the frozen min_hist_frozen scale convention); long positive (initiators), short negative (omitters), normalized to gross 1.0 (0.5 per leg); abstain if either leg < 5 names or the cohort scoreable floor (< 30 mapped-sector assertable exposures at D) is unmet. The zero-state mass carries near-zero weights by construction and contributes the control mass of the cross-section

neighbour_arm.spec: identical machinery, eligibility, clock, book form, floors and fills, with the exposure recomputed as the signed PAYMENT-COUNT CHANGE X' = paid_now - paid_prev (continuous integer-valued), computed only where the state is assertable under the same absence rule. Materially different construction, declared mechanism content: the Lintner partial-adjustment channel operates on the whole payout stream, not only on discrete breaks - a payment-frequency change (e.g. a special/regular mix shift or a schedule change) is the low-salience continuous face of the same commitment. If only the discrete +-1 break state carries the effect, the priced object is the policy break; if only the continuous count face carries it, it is the smoothing channel; concordance supports the family, and an effect that exists ONLY through the break state downweights the smoothing reading. The neighbour changes exactly one thing (the exposure algebra) and nothing else

control_arms.spec: deterministic within-decision, WITHIN-SECTOR permutation sham (matched windows on permuted conditioning; the V5/V6 sham standard carried in p3 lane mandates, and the V12-A6 precedent control form): at each scored decision date, the anchor's exposure VALUES are permuted across that date's eligible names INSIDE each mapped sector tag using a frozen deterministic hash order (sha256 of the string cycle|{hypothesis_id}|{cik}|{decision_index}, hex-sorted - no RNG library, byte-reproducible). The permutation preserves the exact within-date and within-sector multiset of states (+1/-1/0 counts per sector), the exact eligibility set, the exact demeaning and MAD-scale machinery, and all fill/cost/dead-leg machinery, while destroying the name-to-state link. RUNNABILITY by construction: it abstains exactly where the anchor abstains and can never abort on data semantics (forex V3 lesson); every input is a staged dividend record, a staged price bar and a pinned cohort tag. Refutation semantics: if the sham reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x expectancy, or outrunning a negative anchor), the priced object was size, sector composition or death-tail structure rather than transition information, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. This control knowingly walks into the death-tail composition question; that is its purpose

falsification_rule: FROZEN, no gate weakened to admit a thin margin (P-2 margins recorded per gate per arm, never traded away): (1) CONTROL REPRODUCTION -> DEAD: control expectancy same-sign >= 0.5x the anchor's, including the negative-anchor case (the control never outruns a negative anchor); (2) SELF-SUBSUMPTION -> DESIGN FAILURE killed PRE-SCORE: pooled Spearman rho between anchor and control exposure vectors > 0.98 (the sham was not executed as declared); (3) anchor expectancy <= 0 after base band costs -> REJECT; (4) NOVELTY -> DEAD PRE-SELECTION: pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the declared conditioning exposure X and ANY of the FOURTEEN veto entries, measured at D2 on the same (entity, decision-date) cohort, fail-closed; (5) STRESS: stress x2 PnL <= 0 or stress PF < 1.0 -> dead; (6) DROP-ONE failure (symbol or fold) -> dead; (7) REPRODUCTION: twin rerun not ALL_MATCH -> dead; (8) FLOORS: any floor abstained under count -> INFEASIBLE (declared terminal, never a silently reduced book); (9) P2 COVERAGE: dividends-family fold-window coverage cannot fund the floors over the 27 scored grid dates -> INFEASIBLE at P2 (the declared kill point, before any scored cell). REJECT is a successful research outcome

expected_failure_mode.most_likely_measured_kill: the CONTROL retains a large fraction of the anchor's expectancy: in a death-inclusive cohort, omission (short-leg) incidence concentrates in the dying tail, so a naive dividend book may be harvesting cohort composition (death-process expression) rather than transition information - the within-sector permutation sham discriminates exactly this, and a sham reproduction is the EXPECTED binding refutation, accepted without argument (V4/V9/V10/V11/V12 precedent)

expected_failure_mode.third_risk: cost knife-edge at band B/C on a 21-session hold with quarterly sampling (P-2 knife-edge doctrine): if the drift is real but slow, the 15-25 bps/side realized cost can erase it - the honest central expectation is a small margin either way
expected_failure_mode.declared_not_a_risk_here: momentum adjacency is declared LOW-risk by construction for the ANCHOR (existence states have no price geometry) but is nonetheless MEASURED at D2, never argued; for the split family (SFV13-A6-P2) it is the binding risk, not here
